title: Progress on Framework for Equitable Sharing of Losses Between Scam Victims and Financial Institutions
what_it_is: Progress on Framework for Equitable Sharing of Losses Between Scam Victims and Financial Institutions

sections.label: Scam loss-sharing framework
sections.summary: MAS is working with industry to finalise a framework for equitable sharing of scam losses, and the Payments Council proposed draft responsibilities for financial institutions and consumers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS is working with the industry to finalise a framework for the equitable sharing of losses resulting from scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Payments Council has proposed a draft set of responsibilities relevant to financial institutions and consumers.

sections.label: Police anti-scam enforcement results
sections.summary: From January to June 2022, Police froze over 7,800 accounts and recovered over S$80 million, and the Anti-Scam Command arrested or called up over 4,300 scammers and money mules.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: From January to June 2022, the Police froze more than 7,800 accounts and recovered more than S$80 million worth of scam proceeds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since the formation of the Singapore Police Force’s Anti-Scam Command in March this year, more than 4,300 scammers and money mules who were involved in more than 12,000 scam cases involving S$101 million were either arrested or called up for investigation.

sections.label: Shared responsibility loss-sharing principle
sections.summary: The major principle is to design a fair and effective framework with shared responsibility across different parties, which is taking longer than expected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the loss-sharing framework, I think the major principle is for us to find a good platform in which to design a fair and effective framework such that many of the different parties have a shared responsibility, all aspects of it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: It is taking us longer than expected because to put in all of the key aspects in place requires us to make sure where the shared responsibility lies equitably across all of the different stakeholders.

sections.label: Equitable risk-sharing framework consultation
sections.summary: MAS and other agencies are looking into the equitable sharing framework, taking into account the continuum between error and unforced error, and do not track those data at this point.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Maybe I will share about the second question first with regard to the equitable risk-sharing framework on the continuum between the error as well as the unforced error.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: These are issues or steps that we are taking proactively within consultation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: MAS, with regard to the other agencies, are looking into this equitable sharing framework and will take into account both this broad continuum because the instance where a scam is being perpetrated, as well as the discovery, these are all quite critical in terms of finding the perpetrator, in terms of making sure that there is recovery as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the first question, at this point in time, we do not track those data.
